rationale_overall: The watchlist is already at the 16-ticker cap and spans every wave named in the thesis: AI (MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA), rockets/spacecraft (RKLB, LUNR, ASTS), robotics (BOTZ), quantum (IONQ), nuclear fuel cycle (LEU, CCJ), defense/geopolitical (LMT, ITA), tanker/commodity (STNG), demographics/healthcare (ISRG, CTRE), and the SPY benchmark. Q4 2024 diligence found the thesis intact everywhere and no fundamental breach: RKLB's Nov-12 Q3 print showed revenue +55% YoY to $105M with backlog at $1.05B; LMT closed its Terran Orbital acquisition Oct-30; ASTS's Nov-14 update confirmed its first five BlueBird satellites unfolded; LEU won a third DOE domestic LEU/HALEU award in December; ISRG's Oct-17 Q3 print showed da Vinci procedure growth of 18% YoY; CTRE signed a ~$500M skilled-nursing portfolio deal Oct-29; NVDA's Nov-20 Q3 FY25 print posted record data-center revenue of $30.8B (+112% YoY). Nothing in discovery cleared the guardrails for a swap: the NuScale/ENTRA1-TVA SMR deployment and the first major humanoid-robotics IPO both surfaced but could not be dated on or before 2024-12-31 and were excluded per as-of-date discipline. Net effect: no change this rebalance.
